results.note: Assembled by hand from the drawn blocks in Figure 2a (T3A tris(3-aminopropyl)amine; L5 = NHS ester of 6-maleimidohexanoate, five CH2; C10 = 1-decanethiol) and the stated one-pot chemistry: amide at each primary amine, thiosuccinimide at each maleimide. Written with a different ring traversal and atom order from enumerate_library.py's fragment assembly, so the comparison tests connectivity rather than echoing the builder.

Built from an explicit V2000 atom/bond table typed from Scheme 1's drawn product, parsed with Chem.MolFromMolBlock. No SMILES fragment, no string concatenation of chemistry, no RWMol, no AddBond and no RemoveAtom in this file; the enumerator (stage03_enumerate.py) uses curation/lib/assemble.attach, i.e. RWMol+AddBond on SMILES fragments. Writing the anchor as a SMILES read tail-first from the drawing WOULD have collided: the enumerator's canonical string for this lipid already starts at the pentyl tail. Regiochemistry (S on the methacrylate beta carbon, methyl on alpha) is from the two-step synthesis, which is the only evidence that distinguishes it -- the swapped assignment has the same formula and the same exact mass.

NO SECOND ANCHOR EXISTS. Figure 1b draws the 15 amine cores and the 31 thiol tails as separate building blocks and Figures 2b and 3a draw amine cores only, so Scheme 1's 3A4-SC5 is the ONLY complete lipid this paper draws. The absence is recorded here rather than left invisible: 488 of the 489 enumerated structures have no drawn counterpart to test against, and C10 therefore covers 1 of them.

Independently derived: amine half typed by hand from Fig 2a (p.5), 5-carbon linker from Fig 1b (p.3), sterol taken VERBATIM from provenance/reagent_registry.json (cholest-5-en-3beta-ol, InChIKey HVYWMOMLDIMFJA-DPAQBDIFSA-N), assembled by string substitution with no RWMol/AddBond/RemoveAtom anywhere -- see make_reference.py. Replaces an earlier anchor that was a byte-for-byte copy of 03_enumerated.csv and therefore could only pass (F-013); that copy stored epicholesterol while its note claimed 3-beta. LIMIT: the sterol's eight stereocentres come from the registry, not from a fresh read of the figure, so this anchor cannot catch an error in the registry entry itself. Agrees with 03_enumerated.csv; the two were derived by different routes (see this file's docstring), so the agreement is evidence rather than a tautology.

Derived from Figure 1A, which draws the complete reaction 306 + 4 Oi10 -> 306Oi10 with every bond. Built by STRING SUBSTITUTION of four short fragment literals into a tail-first template (make_reference.py): no RWMol, no AddBond, no RemoveAtom, no CombineMols and no RDKit reaction anywhere, so it shares no assembly code with stage03_enumerate.py, which builds every bond through curation/lib assemble.attach from an atom-mapped head. The traversal order is also different on purpose -- the template starts at an isopropyl terminus and walks inward, which RDKit's canonical order does not. WHAT IT TESTS THAT NOTHING ELSE CAN: the SUBSTITUTION COUNT (four tails, two on each primary nitrogen, none on the tertiary one). Formula and exact mass are consequences of that count, not evidence for it. LIMIT: Oi10 is 'isodecyl acrylate', a commercial branched-isomer mixture; the 8-methylnonyl branch is the one the authors DREW, so this anchor inherits that claim rather than testing it, and every Oi10 row in 03_enumerated.csv carries structure_assumed = 1.
